name: Tejalapan Zapotec
world_status: accessible description is silent on stress

earlier_scan.note: Only sociolinguistic/classificatory refs (Rendon 1971/1975, Smith Stark 1994); no phonology or grammar of Tejalapan Zapotec located.

sources.citation: LINGMEX: Bibliografía Lingüística de México desde 1970 (Barriga Villanueva, El Colegio de México), search 'Tejalápam'/'Tejalapam'/'Tejalapan'/'tiza', 2026-09-17.
sources.note: Bibliographic database: exactly one record for this variety (Ramírez Polo 2023, tagged Documentación Lingüística / Sociolingüística / Fonética y Fonología).

sources.citation: Beam de Azcona, Rosemary G. 2023. Realis morphology and Chatino's role in the diversification of Zapotec languages. Diachronica 40(1):1-58 (preprint); and Beam de Azcona 2023, The historical dialectology of stative morphology in Zapotecan, JHL 13(1) (preprint).
sources.access_detail: a digital copy (available on request); access check: a digital copy exists, behind a library sign-in (also a publisher record (DOI), probably paywalled)
sources.note: Checked the language-sample appendix: 'Etla Zapotec' is Santo Tomás Mazaltepec [zpy]; Tejalápam is not sampled. Nothing on Tejalápam stress.

sources.citation: Ramírez Polo, Elías Salvador. 2023. Documentación lingüística del Tilla daa' (lengua nube) zapoteco de San Felipe Tejalápam. Tesis de Licenciatura, Universidad Nacional Autónoma de México (asesora: Ana Isabel Tsutsumi Hernández). 181 pp. TESIUNAM 0839830.
sources.note: Nothing. Chapter 4 'Corpus sonoro del tilla daa'' (pp. 77-97) lists c. 500 words/phrases in a practical orthography keyed to audio samples; many items carry an acute accent (Bíco 'perro', Bakúela 'totomoxle', Ballaní 'amanecer', ¿Ate guchína? '¿ya llegaste?') but the accent mark is never explained and there is no phonological analysis; 'acento', 'tono', 'sílaba' do not occur in the text. Annex pp. 137-166 reproduces Mejía Vázquez's manuscript community dictionary as images.

sources.citation: Valiñas Coalla, Leopoldo. 2019. 'Zapoteco de los Valles Centrales'. Diccionario Enciclopédico de las Lenguas Indígenas de México (DELIM), elem.mx/lenguas/datos/232.
sources.note: Lists 'la de San Felipe Tejalápam o tizá.. iso 639-3 [ztt]' among Valley variants; no phonology, nothing on stress.

sources.citation: Beam de Azcona, Rosemary G. 2016. Zapotecan languages. Oxford Research Encyclopedia of Linguistics (author preprint).
sources.note: No Tejalápam data at all (a full-text search for stress/accent full text); family overview only.

sources.citation: Rendón, Juan José. 1971. Relaciones externas del llamado idioma papabuco. Anales de Antropología 8:213-231 (UNAM-IIA).
sources.note: Only professionally transcribed Tejalápam data in print (100-word Swadesh list of San Felipe Tejalápam among 10 Zapotec lists); Rendón's transcriptions may mark stress/tone and the text may comment on Tejalápam phonology. Open access journal but revistas.unam.mx (article/view/22929) is an automated-access block-walled by automated download.

sources.citation: Robles Reyes, Enrique. 2015. Sorho mi bingulha na' - El tesoro de mis antepasados. Banco de palabras de la lengua zapoteca [variante de San Felipe Tejalápam]. Oaxaca. 127 pp. (community word bank, Taller de lectura y escritura).
